game: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Demo (Grand Prix cup 1, all 3 races)
notes: DRAFT. Same menu route as SonicDemo.json, then the whole cup instead of pausing after 40 s. ACCELERATE IS SPACE (or LMB), not W: the default keyboard layout ('Accelerate A' scheme; the pad's A button) is Space accelerate, C/RMB brake, A/D steer, E or LShift drift, Q item, T gadget, F rear view, W/S item throw direction, I/J/K/L air tricks, Tab pause (Esc also pauses). W is the forward item throw, which is why SonicDemo.json's W/A/D left the car at speed 000. In menus Space confirms, C goes back, F on the hub is the Steam store (never), T on the ready screen toggles 핸들 어시스트 (steering assist, ON by default: keep it on, it keeps a randomly steered car off the walls). The race keys are chords that keep Space held while steering / drifting / using items (gamepilot holds every part of a+b+c). Character select row 1: SONIC, TAILS, KNUCKLES, AMY (the only open ones; locked cells are navigable and Space on one opens a store dialog): char_right 0-3 from SONIC. Class select starts on 하이 스피드 (High): 노멀 (Normal) is left of it, 소닉 스피드 (Sonic Speed) right; 슈퍼 소닉 / 미러 are locked. Cup 1 = E-스타디움 > 레인보우 가든 > 워터 팰리스; each race opens with a 'ROUND n <course>' banner (round_banner), so a race ends when the next banner shows; Space every 4 s while the race HUD is gone gets through the results screens. About 12-15 min per cup. Progress goes to app.sav (Steam Cloud on; demo progress carries over to the full game).
